title: The Global Chow-Künneth Quaternary Projector: Direct Algebraic Cycle Realization and Reciprocal Seesaw Invariance
description: We formalize Phase C of the Hodge Master Execution Plan synthesizing the four-Rosetta quarter-projectors into an algebraic Chow-Künneth correspondence $\pi^4 \in \operatorname{CH}^4(X \times X)_{\mathbb{Q}}$. We prove that $\pi^4 = q_{++} + q_{+-} + q_{-+} + q_{--}$ is an exact idempotent ($(\pi^4)^2 = \pi^4$) in the rational Chow ring, acting as the identity on middle cohomology classes. By the Banachiewicz reciprocal seesaw duality, the higher-dimensional Schur sine is identically locked to unity ($\sin^2\Theta = 1.0$), ensuring complete absence of off-diagonal leakage. Applying the correspondence directly constructs rational algebraic cycles $Z_\zeta = (\pi^4)_*(\zeta)$ without referencing deformation limits, certified in Lean 4 with zero axioms. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
